ploidy_detail: ~8-10x (modern sugarcane hybrid); the paper works on a single biparental cross and does not filter subgenomes, so copy number is not modelled
outcome_definition: Tier 1 'genotyped': clear fluorescence signal in BOTH parents of GT21 x ROC25. Tier 2 'in line with the map': the KASP genotype of the two parents reproduces the SNP genotype in the genetic map (Supplementary Table 10). Both are a two-parent assay outcome, not a population call rate.
source_file: Supplementary Table 10 (sheet S10 of Table_1.XLSX, 24 assay rows); the 77 and 49 tiers exist only as the sentence "Among the 77 SNPs selected for KASP assays, 49 were successfully genotyped in the two parents, and 24 SNPs were in line with genotypes in our genetic map" (Results)
